His first child, **Nevada Alexander Musk**, passed away from **SIDS** in 2002. In the early 2020s, he had children with the singer Grimes, including a son named **X Æ A-12**, whose name caused a massive internet buzz. His younger sister, **Tosca Musk**, is the co-founder of the film streaming service **Passionflix**.

The "lady who claimed to be related to him" is **Rachel Dolezal** (now known as Nkechi Amare Diallo), who gained notoriety for claiming to be Black despite being born to white parents. In the early 2020s (specifically in 2021), she made headlines by claiming she was related to Elon Musk (suggesting they shared a common ancestor or were "cousins").

According to biographical details and articles from the early 2020s regarding her background, Rachel Dolezal was born on November 12, 1977, to her mother, **Ruthanne Dolezal** (née Schertel), and father, Lawrence Dolezal. Ruthanne Schertel was born in **1954**. Therefore, at the time she gave birth to Rachel in 1977, she was **23 years old**.
